description: RIYADH: The chiefs of staff of the Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani armed forces held talks in Riyadh on Friday to discuss support for the Kingdom in the face of escalating attacks against Saudi Arabia by the Houthis in Yemen. The senior military officials agreed to deepen their military and intelligence cooperation, and enhance the integration of defensive capabilities under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement signed last month by the three countries

title: Ireland’s Knight says Israel match should not be played
description: Irish midfielder Jason Knight has stated that his country’s Nations League match against Israel should not go ahead, amid ongoing calls for a boycott of the fixture.

title: Colombia’s new US-backed government cuts ties with Iran
description: Colombia’s new right-wing government has cut diplomatic ties with Iran, marking a significant foreign policy shift that aligns the country more closely with the United States under President Abelardo de la Espriella.

title: Dominicans warned against being lured by Russia to fight in Ukraine
description: The Dominican Republic has warned its citizens against fraudulent employment offers in Russia that are being used as a front to recruit fighters for the war in Ukraine. The foreign ministry advised caution after receiving complaints about the scheme.

title: Inside Trump's "super intelligence" naming problem
description: President Trump is pushing world leaders and U.S. agencies to rename AI "super intelligence."Why it matters: "Superintelligence" already has a distinct meaning in AI — and is fueling debates over whether the most advanced systems should be slowed or stopped.The big picture: Superintelligence — broadly, AI that surpasses human cognition — has become both an industry ambition and the focus of efforts to slow its development or ban it altogether.Yes
